patches.name: hidden-window-creation
patches.description: Honor WindowOptions.show before mapping a newly created native window.

patches.name: file-drop-pointer-modality
patches.description: Treat external file drag movement and drops as pointer input, so a drop after typing still hit-tests its target.

patches.name: test-window-accessibility
patches.description: Activate accessibility in test-support windows, let tests send an AccessKit action request, and report disabled, read-only, invalid, modal, and live states in the debug tree dump, so accessibility trees and actions can be asserted.

patches.name: keystroke-held-flag
patches.description: Report a key-down's is_held repeat flag on the KeystrokeEvent that keystroke interceptors receive, so a key recorder can ignore a held key's repeats.

patches.name: keybinding-load-with-os
patches.description: Restore a KeyBinding loader that takes an explicit keyboard mapper and host OS instead of an App, so keymaps compile and match outside a running application.

patches.name: native-key-identity
patches.description: Preserve native layout, raw Shift, and US physical key identity for terminal keyboard encoding without changing Keystroke binding equality.

patches.name: a11y-window-bounds
patches.description: Send the window's bounds to the platform accessibility adapter when assistive technology activates it and on every move or resize while it is active. The Linux adapters implement a11y_update_window_bounds, but nothing called it, so AT-SPI reported window coordinates as screen coordinates and the window frame had no extents. X11 reads the bounds with a server round trip, so windows skip it while no assistive technology is connected.

patches.name: x11-file-drop
patches.description: Validate complete X11 URI lists, prefer URI offers, and isolate stale selection replies per drag.

patches.name: fullscreen-state-notification
patches.description: Notify bounds observers when X11 fullscreen state changes without a geometry event.

patches.name: x11-key-repeat
patches.description: Enable XKB detectable auto-repeat and mark an X11 key press whose key is still down as held, as macOS and Wayland already do. Keep the real releases that GPUI's event reducer would drop: with the flag granted, a release before a fast press of its key, and in any mode, a release that another release follows.

patches.name: native-key-identity
patches.description: Preserve native layout, raw Shift, and US physical key identity for terminal keyboard encoding without changing Keystroke binding equality.

patches.name: a11y-window-bounds
patches.description: Report the window's screen rectangle as AccessKit's root bounds. X11 reads the window's root origin from the server with the existing get_root_position helper, because GPUI's stored origin can be relative to the window manager's frame, and uses the X window's own rectangle, because GPUI's coordinates start there with client-side decoration insets included. Wayland, which has no global position, reports the window's size at the origin, so the window frame has extents.

patches.name: bounded-notification-waits
patches.description: Cap the system notifications that keep a thread and a session-bus connection waiting for the user's response. Past the cap, a notification is shown without waiting, so a program that keeps notifying cannot accumulate threads while a daemon retains its notifications.

patches.name: macos-offscreen-screen
patches.description: Treat a fully offscreen window as not maximized, and read its backing scale from NSWindow while it has no NSScreen.

patches.name: macos-offscreen-frame
patches.description: Expose per-window opt-in to unconstrained offscreen frames while preserving normal AppKit constraints by default.

patches.name: native-key-identity
patches.description: Preserve native layout, raw Shift, and US physical key identity for terminal keyboard encoding without changing Keystroke binding equality.

patches.name: vm-display-link
patches.description: Pace windows with CVDisplayLink instead of CAMetalDisplayLink when kern.hv_vmm_present reports a virtual machine, where the Metal link stops issuing updates, and print the selected frame source once when GPUI_FRAME_SOURCE_DEBUG is set.

patches.name: accessibility-view-adapter
patches.description: Attach the AccessKit adapter to GPUI's own view rather than the window's content view. GPUIView is a subview of the content view and the first responder, and AppKit resolves the application's focused element from the first responder, so an adapter on the content view left AX clients with the window instead of the focused node.

patches.name: nerd-font-symbols
patches.description: Load Symbols Nerd Font, which has no 'm' glyph, as a primary font: add it to the icon-font exception that already admits Segoe Fluent Icons. Huterm draws Nerd Font icons from that face and never measures it by its 'm'.

patches.name: nerd-font-symbols
patches.description: Load Symbols Nerd Font (PostScript name SymbolsNF), which has no 'm' glyph, as a primary font: add it to the icon-font exception that already admits Segoe Fluent Icons. Huterm draws Nerd Font icons from that face and never measures it by its 'm'.

patches.name: macos-exclusive-registration
patches.description: Use exclusive Carbon hotkey registration so conflicting macOS grabs fail instead of succeeding without event delivery, and report that conflict as AlreadyRegistered.

patches.name: child-nofile-limit
patches.description: Let callers set the child's RLIMIT_NOFILE between fork and exec, so a parent that raised its own soft limit can restore the original for children.

patches.name: visible-character-range
patches.description: Answer accessibilityVisibleCharacterRange with the whole document range for nodes that support text ranges, and allow the selector for them, so AX clients can read the range a viewport-only terminal shows.

patches.name: caret-frame
patches.description: While the selection is collapsed, answer accessibilityFrameForRange: for a zero-length range at it with the bounds of the node's Role::Caret child when it has one, so the caret reports a non-empty rectangle; a selection with extent, and every other range, keeps AccessKit's answer.

patches.name: terminal-selection-with-text
patches.description: For a Role::Terminal node, post one ValueChanged per text change, from its runs or its own value, then SelectedTextChanged when it has a selection; also post SelectedTextChanged when its caret child's bounds change. A collapsed caret's UTF-16 offset can move while its raw position does not. Never post LayoutChanged.
